description.value: You earned a living wrenching precious minerals from the lightless depths of the earth. Adventuring might have seemed lucrative or glamorous compared to this backbreaking labor and if you have to head back underground, this time you plan to do so armed with a real weapon instead of a miner's pick. At least now the things trying to kill you might be guarding treasure instead of just being cave-ins.

system.skillBonuses: Might 3, Athletics 3, Perception 3, Craft: Mason 3, +56 XP
system.startingEquipment:
Lantern
work clothes
hemp rope
work boots
system.features: Underground Sense: You can navigate underground spaces and identify minerals and stone quality.
